Specific cost invariant: capture(pane,u32::MAX) does NOT capture history. crates/tmux/src/lib.rs uses the same capture-pane -p -t argv for every positive line count, then trims locally. Reading the whole visible screen adds no IPC capture/launch. The existing spawn wait polls at 50ms per waiting spawn; trust detection scans visible rows; optional trust-folder sends at most one fixed MenuKey/s per opted-in prompted wait, counted by existing tmux.send-keys. R2's allocated safe_answer guidance is built only for the terminal refusal, not every opt-in tick.
